jobs.description: Got questions? Frequently asked questions Everything you need to know about finding jobs in Pakistan. What are the most in-demand jobs in Pakistan? The most in-demand jobs include software development , digital marketing, healthcare , and engineering roles . The IT industry is rapidly growing, providing high-paying opportunities. How can I find government jobs in Pakistan? You can find government jobs through official portals like FPSC , PPSC , and provincial websites. What is the average salary in Pakistan? Salaries vary by industry. For instance, the average salary for software engineers is PKR 60,000 to 150,000, while teachers earn PKR 30,000 to 80,000 per month. Where can I find remote jobs in Pakistan? Remote jobs are available in IT, customer service, and content writing. Mustakbil.com offers a section dedicated to remote job listings . How do I apply for jobs on Mustakbil.com? Simply create a profile, search for jobs using keywords or filters, and apply online. It's fast, free, and easy! Does Mustakbil.com offer a resume builder? Yes, Mustakbil.com provides an AI-enabled online resume builder that assists job seekers in creating professional and tailored resumes. Which companies are hiring in Pakistan? Major companies like Jazz, Ufone, Engro, Unilever, and multinational IT firms are frequently hiring across Pakistan. Can I find part-time jobs in Pakistan? Yes, part-time jobs are available in retail, education, and freelancing. Check our part-time jobs section.
